fields.label: Integration Username
fields.description: The integration user authorized for this application. Configure a third-party application and authorize its user in Kingdee Cloud Galaxy Enterprise.

fields.label: Application ID
fields.description: The Kingdee third-party application ID. Configure a third-party application and authorize its user in Kingdee Cloud Galaxy Enterprise.

fields.label: Application Secret
fields.description: The application secret used by LoginByAppSecret. Configure a third-party application and authorize its user in Kingdee Cloud Galaxy Enterprise.

fields.label: Locale ID
fields.description: Optional Kingdee locale ID. The default is Simplified Chinese (2052).
